meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infers candidate gene regulatory networks from bulk or single-cell expression data using AertsLab Arboreto GRNBoost2 and GENIE3. Use for transcription factor-target association ranking, compatible Dask execution, sparse expression inputs, and network stability checks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把基因表达数据变成候选基因调控网络并排出调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有表达数据、想找出哪些转录因子调控了哪些基因。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have expression data and want to find which transcription factors regulate which genes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会写并运行 Python 代码调用 arboreto 的 GRNBoost2 或 GENIE3,从表达矩阵推断调控网络,产出含 TF、target、importance 三列的结果表。
howto.when: 当你提供 bulk 或单细胞表达数据,并要求推断基因调控网络、筛选转录因子-靶基因关联等任务时接管。
howto.what_en: After installing, Claude writes and runs Python that calls arboreto's GRNBoost2 or GENIE3 to infer a gene regulatory network from an expression matrix, returning TF, target and importance columns.
howto.when_en: Use it when you supply bulk or single-cell expression data and ask to infer a gene regulatory network or rank transcription factor-target associations.

say_en.text: Infer a network from expression_data.tsv with GRNBoost2, seed 777
say_en.note: Writes and runs the inference script

say_en.text: Run several seeds and keep only TF-target links with importance above 0.5
Run GENIE3 on a local Dask cluster with 10 workers to compare
